posts.headline: The Dow fell more than 1,100 points on AI fears Wednesday — then clawed every one back by the close.
posts.source: Source: U.S. market close, Nov. 25, 2026 (CNBC, Motley Fool)
posts.caption:
The market gave everyone whiplash the day before Thanksgiving.

AI-bubble fears hammered Wall Street Wednesday. Chip stocks led the plunge, the Nasdaq sank as much as 4.6%, and Nvidia finished down 3.9%. At its worst the Dow was off more than 1,100 points.

Then a late-day wave of buying flipped the whole day: the Dow closed HIGHER, and the Nasdaq pared its loss to just 0.6%.

Why it's your money: that stomach-churning swing is exactly what your 401(k) and index funds did too. The handful of AI names that powered this year's gains are now the ones shaking the hardest.

My take: a day that ends nearly flat but swings 1,100 points in between isn't a calm market — it's a nervous one looking for a reason to move. Don't let one wild session rewrite a long-term plan.

Did Wednesday's swing make you check your account? 👇

Source: U.S. market close, Nov. 25, 2026 (CNBC, Motley Fool)
